483-1116-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-1116-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1753-2023-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-4247-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-4247-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

5254-5256-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5256-5902.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

2738-4871-5686-6112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

579-1978-5139-5793.description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding four mana due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Relic of Sauron which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

2590-5776-7297-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

4365-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
4365-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
4365-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Mondrak.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Mondrak
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Mondrak.
Repeat from step 5.

1061-3963-7679.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1061-3963-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Meneldor.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

3923-4050-6747-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
3923-4050-6747-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Sami.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1624-1927-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

140-3238-7433.description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

891-997-3055.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

423-1437-3177-5233--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3177-5233--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

826-3899-6243-7220.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3899-6243-7220.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Glamermite.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Glamermite.
When Glamermite dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Glamermite from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Glamermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

628-2438-7216.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1978-5056-7203.description:
Cause Brigid to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brigid.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-4068-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2085-4068-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3499-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

862-997-4053-6989.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

662-1978-6479.description:
Cause Rainveil Rejuvenator to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat from step 2.

3293-5226-5721-6763.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5226-5721-6763.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5226-5721-6763.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

225-539-573-872.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that can tap to deal damage

requires.n: Permanent tapping to deal damage to any target

283-4831--96.description:
Activate the creature hat can deal damage by tapping it, targeting Cacophodon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying the creature's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Resolve the creature's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target and then dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping the creature that deals damage.
Repeat.
283-4831--96.notes: The permanent you choose to deal damage must either be a creature or must be able to give the ability to a creature (such as an Aura or Equipment). That creature then must have Illusionist's Bracers attached to it and not have summoning sickness. You can also target Cacophodon with both abilities to untap an extra permanent each iteration.

944-2421-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-6471.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Will of the Temur.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6471.description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6471.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

2060-2713-3921-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-3921-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

974-1995-5470.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Gauntlets of Light attached to Ghired.
974-1995-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Activate Ghired by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
974-1995-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

1692-4872-5730.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Aberrant Mind Sorcerer.
1692-4872-5730.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Aberrant Mind Sorcerer with haste.
When the Aberrant Mind Sorcerer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and either return Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand, or put Time Warp from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Time Warp if it was put on top of your library.
Repeat.

643-1636-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-4694.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

539-3824-4552.description:
Activate Dronepack Kindred by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, giving Dronepack Kindred +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

618-890-2410.notablePrerequisites: Palladium Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
618-890-2410.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Galvanizer with haste.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1434-1965-3388.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1434-1965-3388.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
Choose to have Moritte of the Frost enter the battlefield as a copy of Omarthis with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Moritte of the Frost triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to put a +1/+1 counter on one of your creatures.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.
